entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit support. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, I'm calling because I'd like to return a VeloBand Cadence Sensor I recently purchased.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I please have your name and order number?
Sure, the name is Alex Smith, and the order number is VF-789012.
Thank you, Alex. I see the order here. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered 18 days ago. To get started, can you tell me a little more? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It works fine, no technical problems. It just doesn't really fit with my workout routine the way I thought it would. I know it's been a couple of weeks, so I was wondering what my options are. Maybe a partial credit?
I understand. Let me just pull up the specific return policy for this item to be certain. One moment please.

Thank you for holding, Alex. I've reviewed the guidelines. For some of our newer items that have direct skin contact, it can be too late to accept a return after a short period, mostly due to hygiene and sanitation concerns. Our official policy for those is very strict. However, for your VeloBand Cadence Sensor, you are well within our 90-day return window.
Oh, really? 90 days? I thought for sure I had missed the cutoff. That's fantastic news.

Not at all. Since it's only been 18 days, we can process a full refund for you, no problem. I have just initiated that return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file right now. Do you see it?
Let me check... yes, I just got it. So I just print this out and send the band back?

That's correct. Just package it in the original box, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days. Was there anything else I could assist you with?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help, Diana. Thank you!
You're very welcome, Alex. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
